entry.title: New: BILL066(26) (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
RELATING TO PUBLIC TRANSIT.

Amends transit fares for individuals with extremely low incomes (Low-Income Transit Fare Program) by expanding eligibility, allowing for a more streamlined application process, expanding verification methods, and simplifying and standardizing the renewal process.

Latest action: Introduced.
